title: California — CCPA / CPRA
law: California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.100 et seq.)
review_note: Draft wording, not reviewed by a lawyer. Used for US brokers when the person lives in California. Section numbers cited: 1798.105 (deletion), 1798.120 (opt out of sale/sharing), 1798.121 (limit use of sensitive data), 1798.130 (45-day response). A lawyer should confirm the citations, whether a registered data broker must also honour requests through the California Delete Act's DROP platform, and the wording of the authorized-agent sentence.

en.subject: CCPA request to delete and opt out — {full_name}{ref_tag}
en.law: As a resident of {state}, I am exercising my rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.100 et seq.), and any other applicable state privacy laws. You must respond within 45 days of receiving this request (§ 1798.130(a)(2)). This request covers all affiliated and successor properties under common ownership or operation.
